verses.text: Of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;

xrefs.text: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
“No, my lord,” Hannah replied. “I am a woman troubled in spirit. I have not had any wine or strong drink, but I have poured out my soul before the LORD.

verses.text: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.

xrefs.text: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us.

verses.text: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.

xrefs.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.

Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.”
But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.

verses.text: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.

xrefs.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”

verses.text: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.

xrefs.text: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

verses.text: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.

xrefs.text: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the Dawn will visit us from on high,
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

verses.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.

xrefs.text: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.
“This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
For You record bitter accusations against me and bequeath to me the iniquities of my youth.

verses.text: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.

xrefs.text: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.

He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

verses.text: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.

xrefs.text: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
But God found fault with the people and said: “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—

verses.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.

xrefs.text: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.
Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
The law came in so that the trespass would increase; but where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

verses.text: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.

xrefs.text: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.

verses.text: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

xrefs.text: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”
The fear of the LORD leads to life, that one may rest content, without visitation from harm.
They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

verses.text: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.

xrefs.text: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.
If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
And He has made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Christ
I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,

verses.text: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.

xrefs.text: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.

verses.text: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.

xrefs.text: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.
So now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant. For Your sake, O Lord, cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary.
My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.

verses.text: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.

xrefs.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

verses.text: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.

xrefs.text: Perhaps the LORD will see my affliction and repay me with good for the cursing I receive today.”
Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!

verses.text: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.

xrefs.text: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death, for they feared the people.
Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.

verses.text: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

xrefs.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.

verses.text: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.

xrefs.text: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.
In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.

verses.text: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.

xrefs.text: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
